headline: Andy Burnham EDGES 🛫 AWAY from Heathrow's 3rd RUNWAY 🍆
text:
Prime Minister 🧑‍⚖️ Andy Burnham 🚫 just FLAT OUT 🛑 refused to BACK 💪 a third 🛫 runway at Heathrow ✈️ after it popped 🫧 out that the whole 🍆 expansion 🏗️ could get delayed ⏳ by up to four years 🕒!! Burnham who as Mayor 👔 of Greater Manchester 🏙️ had already OPPOSED 🚫 the project 🏗️ told Sunday With Laura Kuenssberg 📺 "I think principally it's a matter for London 🏙️ and Londoners 👥." He basically said bro 🧔‍♂️ we gotta hear the VOICE 🗣️ of the people there first 🥇 before I just JUMP 💦 straight in on the back of the consultation 📋!!

Former Chancellor 💰 Rachel Reeves had been CHAMPIONING 🏆 the runway to BOOST 📈 the economy 💵 with a schedule ⏰ to open by 2035 📅 but Heathrow indicated on Saturday 🗓️ it may not be operational before 2039 🕰️!! As Manchester's mayor 👨‍✈️ Burnham had been AGAINST ❌ the project over concerns 😟 that it would delay investment in transport 🚆 for the north 🧭!! When he took office 🪑 he said he was "open-minded" 🤔 about the scheme but now as PM 🧑‍⚖️ he's playing it COY 😏 waiting on that consultation 📝 voice of the locals 👂!!

As he prepared for his first annual Labour Party conference 🏛️ as prime minister 🧑‍⚖️ Burnham said "There's a consultation 📋 but there are different views 🧐 and you have to take those views seriously 😌 in coming to a decision ⚖️." In response Heathrow 🏢 said "We agree with the prime minister that local voices 👄 must be heard 🔊!! We know from consistent polling 📊 over the last decade that communities support our plans for expansion 🏗️ and support is only growing 🌱 over time ⏳." The project estimated to cost £33bn 💷 has attracted opposition from environmental campaigners 🌍 and local resident groups as well as Mayor of London Sadiq Khan 🏙️!!

A third runway would mean demolishing hundreds of homes 🏠 diverting rivers 🏞️ and rerouting a section of the M25 motorway through a tunnel 🕳️!! But it is estimated it would create 100000 jobs 👷 and provide a major boost to the UK economy 💷!! The number of flights ✈️ from the site currently capped at 480000 a year could go up to 720000 or nearly 2000 a day on average 📈!! A new runway has been backed by the unions Unite 🦺 and the GMB too!!

Sharon Graham 🧑‍💼 Unite's general secretary said "A third runway at Heathrow is essential 🛠️ and we need to get going with it!! This is more than just infrastructure 🏗️ It's about investing in the workforce 👷 securing the future of good unionised jobs 💼 and a guaranteed market for UK steel 🏭." Earlier this weekend Heathrow conceded that meeting the original deadline would be increasingly difficult without further steps to simplify the planning process 📋!! It said it hoped to secure planning permission by 2029 📅 and then open the runway "within a decade" 🕒!!

The Department for Transport 🚗 said the timeline had "always been ambitious" 😤 and it would continue to work with stakeholders "at pace" 🏃 on the matter!! Heathrow Airport warns third runway could be delayed by four years ⏳ while Reeves backs third Heathrow runway in growth push 📈!! Andy Burnham staying all cool 😎 on the whole thing like a true northern DADDY 🧔‍♂️ who won't get railed 💦 into a decision until the locals get their turn first 🥇!!
